scope: Prioritized regional scene matrix; intake planning delta only, existing first-three scenes preserved

rows.region: San Diego coastal-slope, irrigated or riparian-influenced yard edge
rows.distinct_from_existing: Shaded intimate oak-litter ground and managed moisture pocket; no sunny coastal wall or open canyon composition
rows.water_access_constraint: Moisture pocket conditional; do not imply dry oak slopes are riparian jungle
rows.seasonal_behavior: Evergreen oak canopy; scattered litter rather than entire orange autumn canopy. Sycamore deciduous variants only if separately specified and supported.

rows.region: San Diego compact coastal urban exterior
rows.distinct_from_existing: Small enclosed urban geometry, diffuse marine morning and side-gate depth; no broad vista, pergola, canyon ridge or terracotta patio duplicate
rows.water_access_constraint: Managed containers; irrigation independent of season
rows.seasonal_behavior: Marine cloud variation without rainforest greenness; no indoor bird/weather assumptions, no snow default.

rows.distinct_from_existing: Evening light study and low-water domestic edge, deferred until first two independent layer sets reviewed
Cool-season soft soil and wetness states, requires visible art/state review

not_implementation: Layer, state, wind and seasonal metadata does not implement animation, weather, physics or runtime integration.
